snippet.title: Scarlet Hunt - A Dark Romance Visual Novel [Teaser]
snippet.description:
"In a dystopian world ruled by vampire lords, an opportunity arises. Participate in a deadly hunt for a chance at freedom... *if* you can outrun your hunters. Will you finally break your chains - or be dragged into the abyss?"

Scarlet Hunt is a dark romance (otome/yuri/gxg/gxb) visual novel. You play as a young woman whose life is about to change forever... Your choices will determine your fate, so pick wisely! Else you might end up on someone's plate...

Follow on Kickstarter! https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/965301113/scarlet-hunt-a-dark-romance-visual-novel

Wishlist on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3541320/Scarlet_Hunt/

https://soft-poison-studio.itch.io/scarlet-hunt
